_comment: Runtime routing defaults for RideIQ's transit engine.
walkSpeed 1.33 m/s is OTP's average-adult default and roughly matches the
walking speed our own walk_graph routing already assumes, so a walk leg
costed by OTP and one costed by routing.py do not disagree with each other.
transferSlack is the buffer a rider needs between alighting and boarding;
too small and the plan looks fast but is not catchable in real life.
